profile.headline: AI Solutions Architect | DevSecOps Engineer | Multi-Cloud Infrastructure & Security | Healthcare IT
profile.jobTitle: AI Solutions Architect / Engineer (Principal Software Engineer)
profile.summary: 25+ years building and delivering software. Principal engineer and leadership roles in healthcare, fintech, and defense.  I own DevSecOps and infrastructure at eNobleon: zero-trust IaC, CI/CD pipelines, and multi-cloud architecture across GCP and AWS. Production-grade, designed for SOC 2 compliance, built using agentic engineering with humans in the loop.

positions.title: AI Solutions Architect / Engineer (Principal Software Engineer)
positions.description:
* Built multi-cloud infrastructure across GCP and AWS using Terraform and GitHub Actions with zero-trust networking. No public database access, no long-lived credentials, IAM-only service auth, secrets in Secret Manager on both clouds. A net-new environment reaches end users in under 2 hours. Designed for developer velocity through continuous delivery.

* Established security as a first-class concern. Implemented shift-left SAST (Semgrep, Trivy) as PR checks, DAST (OWASP ZAP) as nightly scans with auto-filed issues, and Secret Manager integration across both clouds. HTTP security headers scoring Grade A. SOC 2 readiness to reinforce customer trust and support enterprise sales.

* Applied agentic engineering workflows to all of the above. Agents handle implementation under human oversight: spec definition, architectural decisions, and security reviews stay with the engineer.

* Authored ADRs, C4 system and component diagrams, and production readiness assessments to govern architectural decisions across the platform.
